result.cause: The native delivery bridge staged the kickoff but waited for archive before it published message.delivered.
evidence: Both native Codex agents reached ready and working state.
The supervisor delegated through the st3 graph.
The worker committed the correct change and sent a verified report.
The supervisor sent a verified confirmation after the report.
The kickoff had no durable message.delivered claim, so checkpoint zero correctly stayed active.

fix.description: The bridge now publishes delivery after it durably stages an unread message.
